title: Healing at Gennesaret
description: After crossing the sea, Jesus and his disciples came to land at Gennesaret. As soon as they stepped out of the boat, people recognized him and ran throughout that whole region, carrying the sick on stretchers to wherever they heard he was. Wherever he went—into villages, towns, or countryside—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him to let them touch even the hem of his cloak. And all who touched it were healed [ref:Mark 6:53-56|Mark 6:53-56].
